name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_destructor
description: The out-of-line HudUiNumericTextInput destructor disables raw keyboard capture, resets numeric input vtables, destroys the embedded text input, and runs ZRD widget cleanup.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by explicit SEH state temporaries in the decompiler.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4b4ac0 validate setting the numeric text-input base vtable, SetRawKeyboardCapture(0), slider-border vtable reset, embedded HudUiTextInput::DestructorCore, and HudUiZrdWidget::DestructorCore.

The native smoke constructs a numeric text input, enables raw keyboard capture, calls the scalar-deleting destructor with flags=0, and validates callback cleanup plus text-input, slider-border, and final base widget vtable state.

VC5SP3 emits the virtual-destructor symbol ??1HudUiNumericTextInput@@UAE@XZ from zui.cpp; mission-side 0x41a3f0 lifecycle placement is outside this functional target and remains separately unresolved.
